reason: Timing it from when I put the phone down instead of the clock is exactly what my rotating shifts need, and the 14-day trial has no auto-billing, so trying it costs me nothing. If the day-14 numbers actually show I fall asleep faster after day shifts and night shifts, I'd pay 4,900 for one month first, and I'd think about dropping Calm before stacking another subscription.
objection: My bedtime changes every week, and I sleep in the daytime after nights, so I doubt 14 days of alternating is enough for it to learn anything. Phone motion detection probably gets confused when I toss around in a noisy daytime room.
